text:
marie: Quick UX QA on the Playground chat bar v4: focus on streaming display, token pill, stop/regenerate placement. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/mnop/playground-v4 
dan: Suggest keeping a fixed toolbar height and overlaying the token pill to avoid jumps on narrow screens. add a subtle fade for overflow.
ash: For streaming, chunk text every 180ms and update token count every 350ms. show estimates with '~' prefix while streaming.
kelly: Accessibility: add role=status live region that announces 'Generation started' and 'Finished: X tokens'. Stop button should be labeled 'Stop generation' for clarity.
qa-bot: Tests to add: keyboard stop/regenerate, token pill visibility on mobile, aria announcements. I'll add them to the plan.
marie: Action items: Dan implement overlay + fade; Ash add batching; Kelly run a11y check; QA to add tests. Will canary at 5%.
